Yes, the conviction will likely be reversed. Under the prevailing modern view, felony murder doesn't apply when a co-felon is killed by police, because the killing isn't attributed to the felons (agency theory) and the victim was a co-felon, not an innocent person. Most jurisdictions would also bar the charge under the proximate cause or "agency" limits on liability, though the man could still face other charges such as armed robbery and assault.
